name: @probarion/near
description: Building blocks for NEAR apps: verify light_client_proof outcome proofs, read NEP-297 events bound to the contract that emitted them and to receipts that succeeded, audit an account's access keys and code identity, and check a NEAR Intents POA withdrawal. Pure TypeScript; the online helpers take any JSON-RPC client and sign nothing.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if(process.env.CI!=='true'||process.env.GITHUB_WORKFLOW!=='release'){console.error('Refusing to publish: only the GitHub release workflow publishes. Push a tag such as sdk-v0.1.0 instead.');process.exit(1)}"
